title: Sparse Walsh-Pauli Correlation Encoding for MaxCut: A Quantum-Inspired Formulation with Quantum-Hardware Validation
summary: We introduce a sparse Walsh-Pauli correlation encoding for MaxCut, in which graph variables are represented by diagonal Pauli-string expectation values computed classically as normalized XOR autocorrelations of Walsh coefficients. The complete Walsh basis can reproduce the diagonal correlators of arbitrary quantum states, while a structured sparse support reduces the number of trainable coefficients to $m+1$ for $m$ graph variables. We evaluate the method on $1{,}400$ held-out random graphs with up to $7{,}000$ vertices, obtaining empirical approximation ratios near $0.98$ relative to MQLib…
